sources.title: Qwen Image Edit 2509 by Alibaba: AI Image Editing Model | Lumenfall
sources.snippet: Qwen Image Edit 2509 is a specialized vision-language model developed by Alibaba designed for instruction-based image manipulation. Unlike standard text-to-image generators, this model accepts both an initial image and a natural language prompt to perform targeted modifications and transformations.
